news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹37.94 (vs ₹50.69 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹37.94 (down from ₹50.69 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹44.6b (down 2.5% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹2.39b (down 25% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 5.4% (down from 7.0% in FY 2025). Revenue is forecast to grow 3.8% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 13% growth forecast for the Software industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 18% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 25% per year, which means it is performing significantly worse than earnings.

news.body: Over the last 90 days, the stock has fallen 26% to ₹491. The fair value is estimated to be ₹616, however this is not to be taken as a buy recommendation but rather should be used as a guide only. Revenue has grown by 9.7% over the last 3 years. Earnings per share has declined by 12%. Revenue is forecast to grow by 8.1% in 2 years. Earnings are forecast to grow by 102% in the next 2 years.

news.title: ROUTE: Leadership Reshuffle And Stable Margins Will Support Future Upside Potential
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their price target on Route Mobile from ₹875 to ₹766.25, citing updated assumptions for revenue growth, profit margins, and a slightly higher discount rate. This also feeds into a lower expected future P/E multiple.

news.title: Price target decreased by 10.0% to ₹788
news.body: Down from ₹875, the current price target is an average from 4 analysts. New target price is 39% above last closing price of ₹568. Stock is down 48% over the past year. The company posted earnings per share of ₹50.69 last year.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: EPS exceeds analyst expectations while revenues lag behind
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹15.51 (up from ₹13.10 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹11.2b (down 5.4% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹977.0m (up 19% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 8.7% (up from 7.0% in 3Q 2025). Revenue missed analyst estimates by 3.9%. Earnings per share (EPS) exceeded analyst estimates by 18%. Revenue is forecast to grow 7.7% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 14% growth forecast for the Software industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 12% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 23% per year, which means it is performing significantly worse than earnings.

news.title: ROUTE: Stable Forecasts And ESOP Cancellations Will Support Earnings Upside
news.body: Analysts have kept their fair value estimate for Route Mobile steady at ₹875. Small adjustments to the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E assumptions have offset each other, leaving the overall price target effectively unchanged.

news.title: High number of new and inexperienced directors
news.body: There are 5 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: 5 new directors. 1 experienced director. 1 highly experienced director. Co-Founder, MD, CEO & Director Rajdip Gupta is the most experienced director on the board, commencing their role in 2004. The following issues are considered to be risks according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model: Lack of board continuity. Lack of experienced directors.

news.title: Second quarter dividend of ₹2.00 announced
news.body: Shareholders will receive a dividend of ₹2.00. Ex-date: 13th February 2026 Payment date: 11th March 2026 Dividend yield will be 1.7%, which is higher than the industry average of 1.2%. Sustainability & Growth Dividend is well covered by both earnings (41% earnings payout ratio) and cash flows (12% cash payout ratio). The dividend has increased by an average of 41% per year over the past 5 years. However, payments have been volatile during that time. EPS is expected to grow by 142% over the next 3 years, which should provide support to the dividend and adequate earnings cover.
